================================================================================
simple conditional
================================================================================

locals {
  x = a ? b : c
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (conditional
            condition: (expression
              (variable_expr
                (identifier)))
            true_val: (expression
              (variable_expr
                (identifier)))
            false_val: (expression
              (variable_expr
                (identifier)))))))))

================================================================================
conditional with literals
================================================================================

locals {
  env = var.prod ? "production" : "development"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (conditional
            condition: (expression
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier)))
              (get_attr
                name: (identifier)))
            true_val: (expression
              (template_expr
                (quoted_template)))
            false_val: (expression
              (template_expr
                (quoted_template)))))))))
